newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Stanley lists NYC MAC refunding information.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley lists NYC MAC refunding information.

text.p: MUNICIPAL ASSISTANCE CORPORATION FOR
THE CITY OF NEW YORK
(A PUBLIC BENEFIT CORPORATION OF THE
STATE OF NEW YORK)
SERIES G BONDS
ISSUED PURSUANT TO THE 1991 GENL BOND RESOLUTION
MUNICIPAL ASSISTANCE CORPORATION FOR THE CITY OF NEW YORK
SERIES G BONDS. REFUNDING INFORMATION.
SUBSTANTIALLY ALL OF THE PROCEEDS OF THE SERIES G BONDS WILL BE DEPOSITED
INTO A SPECIAL TRUST FUND TO BE HELD BY THE UNITED STATES TRUST COMPANY
OF NEW YORK, AS TRUSTEE UNDER THE SECOND GENERAL BOND RESOLUTION, AND WILL
BE USED TO PURCHASE DIRECT OBLIGATIONS OF THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT.
THE PRINCIPAL AND INTEREST ON THE GOVERNMENT OBLIGATIONS, WHEN DUE, WILL
BE SUFFICIENT TO PROVIDE MONEYS, TOGETHER WITH OTHER AVAILABLE MONEYS,
TO PAY THE REDEMPTION PRICE OF THE REFUNDED BONDS ON JULY 1, 1997.
BECAUSE THE SPECIAL TRUST FUND DOES NOT SECURE OR PROVIDE MONEYS FOR
PAYMENT OF THE INTEREST ON THE REFUNDED BONDS, THE REFUNDED BONDS WILL
CONTINUE TO BE OUTSTANDING UNDER THE SECOND GENERAL BOND RESOLUTION UNTIL
THEIR RETIREMENT ON JULY 1, 1997. UNTIL THEIR RETIREMENT THEY WILL CONTINUE TO
BE ENTITLED TO ALL OF THE BENEFITS, PROTECTIONS AND SECURITY PROVIDED BY THE
SECOND GENERAL BOND RESOLUTION AND WILL ALSO BE SECURED BY THE SPECIAL TRUST
FUND.
SHOWN BELOW ARE THE SERIES OF SECOND RESOLUTION BONDS OF WHICH THE REFUNDED
BONDS ARE A PART, THE OUTSTANDING PRINCIPAL AMOUNT OF BONDS OF EACH SERIES,
THE PRINCIPAL AMOUNT OF EACH SERIES BEING REFUNDED AND THE PRINCIPAL AMOUNT
OF EACH SERIES NOT BEING REFUNDED BY THE SERIES G BONDS.
SERIES OUTSTANDING REFUNDED UNREFUNDED
PRINCIPAL AMOUNT PRINCIPAL AMOUNT PRINCIPAL AMOUNT
BASED ON THE CORPORATION'S CURRENT PLAN OF FINANCE, THE REMAINING PRINCIPAL
AMOUNT OF SECOND RESOLUTION BONDS OF ANY SERIES WHICH WILL BE REFUNDED
IN PART THROUGH THE ISSUANCE OF THE SERIES G BONDS IS EXPECTED TO BE
REFUNDED THROUGH THE ISSUANCE OF ADDITIONAL 1991 RESOLUTION BONDS PRIOR
TO JULY 1, 1997. NO ASSURANCE CAN BE GIVEN, HOWEVER, THAT THE PLAN OF
FINANCE WILL BE COMPLETED AS CURRENTLY CONTEMPLATED OR THAT SUCH REMAINING
SECOND RESOLUTION BONDS WILL BE REFUNDED AND REDEEMED ON JULY 1, 1997.
IN THE EVENT NO ADDITIONAL BONDS ARE ISSUED PRIOR TO JULY 1, 1997 TO
COMPLETE THE PLAN OF FINANCE, THE PRINCIPAL AMOUNT OF EACH MATURITY WITHIN
A SERIES OF THE REFUNDED BONDS THAT WILL BE CALLED FOR REDEMPTION WILL BE
DETERMINED BY THE CORPORATION, SUBJECT ONLY TO ANY LIMITATIONS ON SUCH
SELECTION AS MAY BE IMPOSED BY THE PROVISIONS OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE
CODE OF 1986, AS AMENDED, APPLICABLE TO THE SERIES G BONDS AND THE REFUNDED
BONDS. THE PARTICULAR REFUNDED BONDS WITHIN A MATURITY TO BE REDEEMED WILL
BE SELECTED BY THE TRUSTEE BY LOT.
